title: The Mammal Scientists Thought Was Fake 🦆 #shorts
description: The platypus lays eggs, males carry venom, it hunts with electroreception and it has no stomach.

scenes.text: This mammal lays eggs, has venom, and glows under ultraviolet light.
It's the platypus. When the first specimen reached Britain, scientists suspected it was a fake, stitched together from different animals.
Males have a venomous spur on their back legs. A sting can cause severe pain in humans for weeks.
Underwater it hunts with its eyes, ears and nose shut, sensing the electric fields of its prey through its bill.
And it doesn't even have a stomach.
Follow for one odd lifeform every day.
